title: VILMA: A ZERO-SHOT BENCHMARK FOR LINGUISTIC AND TEMPORAL GROUNDING IN VIDEO-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on action counting tasks using numbers frequently seen during pretraining (easy subtest) versus using those same frequent numbers as incorrect counterfactual foils (difficult subtest) to test if models overcome frequency priors.

Using unimodal text-only baselines and proficiency tests to measure if models rely on linguistic plausibility, textual frequency heuristics, or unimodal pretraining biases rather than true cross-modal temporal grounding.

Evaluating models on temporal reasoning tasks (such as Change of State and Action Counting) and comparing Video-Language Models against static Image-Language Models to determine if they rely on static visual cues rather than understanding temporal dynamics.
